Features

Key Features

Project & Task Management

Drag-and-drop Kanban boards with customizable columns, task hierarchies with subtasks and parent–child relationships, and real-time collaboration for instant team updates.

Built-in CRM

Centralized contact database for clients, leads, and stakeholders, a sales pipeline from first lead to closed deal, and engagement tracking with full interaction history.

HRM & Granular Roles

Employee directory with detailed records, full lifecycle management from onboarding to performance tracking, and precise workspace-level permission control.

Invoicing with Stripe

Generate professional invoices with built-in Stripe integration, automated status tracking (Draft, Paid, Overdue) in real time, and itemized billing with tax and quantity calculations.

Collaborative Docs & Version Control

Internal and external sharing on the same document, full version control that tracks every change, and granular public/private access control.

Multi-Workspace & Multi-Tenancy

Switch seamlessly between organizations, with hard data isolation between workspaces, complete audit logging, and horizontal-scaling architecture from day one.

FAQ

When will Matrix be available?
Matrix is currently in development. Sign up for early access to be among the first to try it when we launch.
How is Matrix different from other project management tools?
Matrix isn't just a task manager — it unifies Project Management, CRM, HRM, Invoicing (with Stripe), and Document Collaboration in one workspace, with data flowing between modules rather than trapped in silos.
Will there be a free plan?
Yes! Matrix will offer a generous free tier for small teams, with premium features available for larger organizations.
Can I import from other tools?
We plan to support imports from popular tools like Notion, Trello, Asana, and Jira at launch.
How does multi-workspace support work?
You can seamlessly switch between organizations or departments from a single login. Each workspace has hard data isolation (multi-tenancy) and its own granular roles, so cross-team access is controlled, not accidental.
Is my data secure and auditable?
Yes — Matrix ships with complete audit logging for traceability and compliance, secure multi-tenancy for data isolation, and horizontal-scaling architecture designed for reliability as you grow.
